listing.name: OpenGTPS1 (Gran Turismo 2)
listing.summary: Windows Gran Turismo 2 project whose upstream repository is no longer public. Its original code never received a license grant; your existing files stay untouched.
listing.download_block_reason: The upstream README states that no license has been granted for original OpenGTPS1 code. The existing canonical permission hold remains: an attributable grant for that code and a reviewed usable player/setup route are required before Portcove can offer acquisition. Licenses of vendored components do not grant rights to the whole project.

steps.title: Check the recorded licensing status
steps.instruction: The upstream repository is no longer public, and the original-code permission hold was never resolved. The linked licensing statement is a historical copy. If the project returns with an attributable grant and a usable reviewed runtime and setup route, Portcove can review it again. This listing does not ask you to download or run anything.

listing.availability_override_reason: GitHub no longer shows this project's repository (checked November 15, 2026). Portcove keeps this listing for reference. If the project becomes available again, Portcove can review it again.
